Build job 7, part 1, of the records-history plan (docs/design/records-history.md sections 4 and 10, decision D111): the cutover. Depends on job 6 (incremental checking, 3d947a7) having landed. Choose C0 as main's tip at the time of the run, run the importer against it, write the legacy-exempt record built from athena.toml's [history] exempt (six entries plus 02837e0) to athena/records, make the attribution check judge commits up to C0 by the legacy rule and after it by records only, and stop writing commit-message trailers in new landings.
Acceptance:
- The importer's self-check passes on this repository and the import commit is on athena/records.
- athena check --attribution passes on main after the cutover.
- A new landing's commit message carries no Athena trailers.
- docs/decisions.md records C0 and the cutover.
Files: crates/athena-core, crates/athena-gate, crates/athena-cli, .github/workflows/ci.yml, docs/decisions.md
